title: gha-runner-scale-set values
description: Only values that require strict validation are described here. Any value not listed is intentionally unconstrained.

scaler.description: Configuration for the Kubernetes clients used by the ghalistener scaler.

qps.description: Queries per second the listener may issue to the Kubernetes API server when patching job started events.

burst.description: Burst of queries the listener may issue to the Kubernetes API server when patching job started events.

scaleQPS.description: Queries per second the listener may issue to the Kubernetes API server when publishing the desired runner count. This is a separate budget from qps so a batch of job event patches cannot delay it.

scaleBurst.description: Burst of queries the listener may issue to the Kubernetes API server when publishing the desired runner count.

workers.description: Number of job started events the listener patches concurrently from its background queue.
